title: Bridging the Data Provenance Gap Across Text, Speech, and Video
authors_zh: Shayne Longpre 等 43 位作者
paper_type_zh: 多模态数据 provenance、许可证与来源条款审计
best_for_zh: 负责后训练数据选型、开放发布、权利复核、来源治理与版本审计的研究者和工程团队
one_line: Releases a human-audited dataset-level catalogue covering 3,916 reported text, speech, and video datasets, with source, derivation, creator, representation, license, and source-terms metadata but no per-record provenance.
发布人工审计的数据集级目录，覆盖论文表中 3,916 个文本、语音与视频数据集的来源、派生、创建者、表示、许可证和来源条款，但不提供逐记录 provenance。
why: For the construction/open-release track, it provides an operational rights and lineage review layer before composing reasoning-data mixtures, and shows that permissive dataset labels can conflict with upstream source restrictions.
inclusion_reason: Supplies a human-audited, cross-modal provenance and restriction layer for selecting and documenting upstream post-training sources, while demonstrating why dataset-level licenses, source terms, versioning, and record-level lineage must remain separate audit objects.

title: Problem
问题
html:
An “open” training dataset can carry a clean dataset-card license while inheriting different restrictions from webpages, platforms, model outputs, or earlier datasets inside it. Repackaging can break the documentation chain: the final release may name neither the original source nor its terms, creator, consent basis, transformation, or applicable restrictions. A team choosing data for SFT, preference learning, or multimodal training therefore cannot infer source compatibility from one top-level license string.

The problem is not limited to text. Speech and video ecosystems use different hosts, publication customs, tasks, size units, and source platforms, so a text-only inventory cannot establish how data sourcing and restrictions change across modalities. At the same time, ecosystem-level claims about geography or language require a declared definition of “creator” and careful denominators; more represented countries or languages do not necessarily mean a less concentrated distribution.

This work asks how to construct a comparable human audit of public text, speech, and video datasets, trace dataset derivations and source terms, and measure longitudinal sourcing, restriction, and representation trends. For this atlas, the resulting catalogue is an audit layer around reasoning and post-training data—not reasoning supervision, a legal-clearance service, or record-level provenance.

一个“开放”训练数据集可能在数据卡上使用宽松许可证，却从其包含的网页、平台、模型输出或上游数据集继承不同限制。反复重打包会切断文档链：最终发布物可能不再说明原始来源及其条款、创建者、同意基础、转换过程或适用限制。因此，负责 SFT、偏好学习或多模态训练的数据团队不能只看一个顶层 license 字符串就推断来源兼容性。

这个问题不限于文本。语音与视频生态采用不同的托管平台、发布习惯、任务、规模单位和来源网站，纯文本清单不足以说明跨模态的数据来源与限制如何变化。与此同时，关于地域或语言的生态结论必须先声明“创建者”的定义并保持分母清楚；代表的国家或语言数量增加，并不自动意味着分布更均衡。

该工作研究如何对公开文本、语音与视频数据集进行可比较的人工审计，追踪数据集派生和来源条款，并衡量长期的来源、限制与表示趋势。在本图谱中，这份目录是围绕推理和后训练数据的审计层，不是推理监督、法律 clearance 服务或逐记录 provenance。

title: Core idea
核心思路
html:
The paper extends the Data Provenance Initiative from an earlier supervised-text audit to a cross-modal catalogue. Table 1 reports 3,916 public datasets: 3,717 text datasets in 108 collections, 95 speech datasets, and 104 video datasets. Together they span 798 sources, 659 creator organizations, 67 countries, 608 languages, 443 tasks, 55 licenses, 2.1T text tokens, and about 1.9M hours of speech and video. Section 2.1 also says 3,713 text datasets, so the two text totals remain an internal paper discrepancy.

The reusable object is structured metadata at collection, dataset, or separable-variant level. Human experts trace papers, repositories, dataset cards, marketplaces, derivation links, licenses, and source terms, then encode identifiers, sources, creators, languages, geography, tasks, model generation, human annotation, derivation, license evidence, and modality-specific properties. The repository also provides taxonomies, analysis plots, downloader/filter/normalization code, and an Attribution Card.

The feedback object is a human audit judgment. Dataset licenses are grouped as Commercial, NC/Acad, or Unspecified. Source restrictions are grouped as Model Closed, Source Closed, Unspecified, or Unrestricted, and aggregation uses the strictest source status; text collections inherit the most restrictive constituent status for collection-level analysis. These labels support screening and comparison, but they are neither legal rulings nor sample-level correctness rewards.

The catalogue does not attach every training record to an original URL, person, consent decision, transformation, or license. It also does not itself supply the audited dataset contents: repository scripts can retrieve and normalize selected underlying datasets, and the official Hugging Face organization hosts several derived text artifacts, but neither should be confused with one complete multimodal paper snapshot.

论文把 Data Provenance Initiative 从早期监督文本审计扩展为跨模态目录。Table 1 报告 3,916 个公开数据集：108 个 collection 中的 3,717 个文本数据集、95 个语音数据集和 104 个视频数据集。它们合计覆盖 798 个来源、659 个创建机构、67 个国家、608 种语言、443 项任务、55 种许可证、2.1T 文本 token，以及约 1.9M 小时语音和视频。§2.1 同时又写成 3,713 个文本数据集，因此两个文本总数是论文内部尚未解释的差异。

可复用对象是 collection、dataset 或可分离变体级的结构化元数据。人类专家追踪论文、仓库、数据卡、marketplace、派生链、许可证和来源条款，再编码标识、来源、创建者、语言、地域、任务、模型生成、人工标注、派生、许可证证据与各模态特有属性。仓库还发布 taxonomy、分析图、下载/筛选/归一化代码和 Attribution Card。

反馈对象是人工审计判断。数据集许可证分为 Commercial、NC/Acad 和 Unspecified；来源限制分为 Model Closed、Source Closed、Unspecified 和 Unrestricted。聚合时采用最严格的来源状态，文本 collection 的 collection-level 分析还继承最严格的 constituent 状态。这些标签可用于筛选和比较，但不是法律裁决，也不是样本级 correctness reward。

该目录不会把每条训练记录连接到原始 URL、个人、同意决定、转换或许可证，也不会直接提供全部被审计数据的内容。仓库脚本可以下载并归一化部分上游数据集，官方 Hugging Face 组织也托管若干派生文本 artifact，但两者都不能被误认为完整的多模态论文快照。

title: Method
方法
html:
Selection is modality-specific rather than one uniform crawl.

  1. Text focuses on public post-training data used for instruction tuning and preference alignment. The team expands an earlier 44-collection, 1,858-dataset audit to 108 collections by combining recent surveys and tools, monthly popular Hugging Face datasets, SFT/DPO releases associated with open models, multilingual catalogues such as SEACrowd, Masader, AI4Bharat, and Aya, and expert review. The paper discusses recent datasets introduced through April 2024 while also describing monthly popularity review from April through July 2024, so there is no single clean cutoff interpretation.
  2. Speech retains datasets where ASR is a primary task. Candidates come from survey repositories, Hugging Face ASR/TTS tags, OpenSLR, and targeted low-resource-language additions. When versions are cumulative, the audit uses the initial release year but recent available metadata; legally or semantically distinct versions can remain separate. Unlabeled hours are excluded, while weakly supervised hours with model-generated transcripts are retained.
  3. Video starts from Hugging Face video task tags, Papers with Code categories, a survey repository, relevant workshops, citation/publication criteria, and a 100-download threshold, then uses external expert review. A shared video source used and annotated for different tasks may count as different datasets.

Annotation follows public evidence chains. Domain experts inspect academic papers, websites, GitHub/Hugging Face/Papers with Code pages, and source policies, sometimes traversing several derivations to reach the original source. The paper says relevant licensing and sourcing information is often lost during repackaging and therefore requires a “full trace” through those documents. Text creator organizations are the affiliations associated with the ML dataset release, not the organizations that own or created the upstream content.

The released JSON is heterogeneous by modality. Text records can include identifiers, dataset and collection URLs, languages, task categories, text sources, generating models, format, human annotation, parent datasets, creators, licenses and URLs, license notes/verifier, filter IDs, BibTeX, platform metadata, and text metrics. Speech adds hours, speakers, ISO languages/families, topics, source/process description, creator categories, year, and location. Video adds video hours, availability/takedown status, countries, source platforms, and task categories. Field presence varies; there is no single fully populated schema shared by every record.

The restriction taxonomy has two axes. Dataset license intent is Commercial, NC/Acad, or Unspecified. Each upstream source is classified as Model Closed, Source Closed, Unspecified, or Unrestricted; the strictest source label is used when sources are aggregated. For collection-level text analysis, a collection inherits the most restrictive status of its constituent datasets. This conservative rule is explicit, but field-completion thresholds, annotator assignment, disagreement resolution, and inter-annotator agreement are unknown.

The official repository contains JSON summaries, constants, plots, downloader/preparer/filtering code, and contribution instructions. Its normalization format can represent multi-turn dialogue and response rankings, but that operational feature belongs to retrieval of selected underlying datasets; it does not turn the audit metadata itself into training examples. Reproducible reuse should pin a repository revision and preserve the evidence URL and timestamp behind every human judgment.

候选选择按模态分别设计，并不是一次统一 crawl。

  1. 文本范围聚焦用于 instruction tuning 与 preference alignment 的公开后训练数据。团队把早期 44 个 collection、1,858 个数据集的审计扩展到 108 个 collection，来源包括近期 survey 和工具、每月热门 Hugging Face 数据集、开放模型关联的 SFT/DPO 发布、SEACrowd、Masader、AI4Bharat、Aya 等多语言目录，以及专家复核。论文一方面讨论截至 2024 年 4 月引入的近期数据，另一方面又描述了 2024 年 4–7 月的月度热度复核，因此不能把 cutoff 简化成一个无歧义日期。
  2. 语音仅保留以 ASR 为主要任务的数据集。候选来自 survey 仓库、Hugging Face ASR/TTS tag、OpenSLR 与针对低资源语言的补充。若版本是累积式的，审计采用初始发布时间和较新可得元数据；法律或语义上不同的版本可以分开。无 transcript 的小时数被排除，使用模型生成 transcript 的弱监督小时数仍保留。
  3. 视频从 Hugging Face 视频任务 tag、Papers with Code 类别、survey 仓库、相关 workshop、发表/引用条件和 100 次下载阈值开始，再由外部专家复核。同一视频来源若服务于不同任务并被重新标注，可能计为不同数据集。

标注沿公开证据链进行。domain expert 检查论文、网站、GitHub/Hugging Face/Papers with Code 页面和来源政策，有时要穿过多层派生关系才能到达原始来源。论文指出，重打包经常丢失 license 与 sourcing 信息，因此需要对这些文档进行“full trace”。文本中的 creator organization 指与 ML 数据集发布相关的 affiliation，不是拥有或创作上游内容的组织。

发布的 JSON 按模态具有不同结构。文本记录可含标识、dataset/collection URL、语言、任务、文本来源、生成模型、格式、人工标注、父数据集、创建者、许可证及其 URL、license notes/verifier、filter ID、BibTeX、平台元数据和文本统计。语音还包含小时、speaker、ISO 语言/语系、主题、来源/流程描述、创建者类型、年份与地域；视频还包含视频小时、可用/下架状态、国家、来源平台和任务类别。字段是否存在因记录而异，并不存在一套对所有记录都完整填充的统一 schema。

限制 taxonomy 有两个轴。数据集许可证意图为 Commercial、NC/Acad 或 Unspecified；每个上游来源为 Model Closed、Source Closed、Unspecified 或 Unrestricted，聚合时采用最严格的来源标签。对于 collection-level 文本分析，collection 继承 constituent 中最严格的状态。这个保守规则已公开，但字段完成阈值、标注者分配、分歧裁决和 inter-annotator agreement 仍为 unknown。

官方仓库包含 JSON summary、constants、图表、downloader/preparer/filter 代码和贡献说明。它的归一化格式可以表示多轮对话与 response ranking，但这是下载部分上游数据时的功能，并不会把审计元数据本身变成训练样本。可复现复用应固定 repository revision，并保留每个人工判断对应的证据 URL 与时间。

title: Evidence
证据
html:
Table 1 is the scale anchor. It reports 3,916 datasets in total: 3,717 text, 95 speech, and 104 video. The audit covers 798 sources, 659 creator organizations, 67 countries, 608 languages, 443 tasks, and 55 licenses. Text contributes 2.1T tokens, while speech and video contribute 775K and 1.13M hours. These are metadata and ecosystem-quantity statistics, not counts of independently verified individual source records.

The main restriction result compares dataset licenses with source terms. The paper reports that only 25%, 33%, and 32% of text, speech, and video datasets are non-commercially licensed, but some non-commercial restriction appears in sources covering 99.8%, 78%, and 99% of their respective token/hour quantities. License/source mismatches account for 79% of text tokens, 55% of speech hours, and 65% of video hours. In the detailed crosstab, less than 0.1% of text content, 5.4% of speech content, and 0.6% of video content are commercially usable under both the paper's license and source-terms categories.

These figures establish documentation conflicts under the paper's taxonomy; they do not decide enforceability or legality. The authors explicitly limit their claim to tracing lineage and the distribution of licenses and terms, acknowledge jurisdiction and use-case dependence, and state that the work does not propose one standard for every developer.

The sourcing analysis reports that 71% of video hours and 69% of speech hours come from YouTube, while general web, encyclopedia, synthetic, and social sources increasingly dominate text. For synthetic text, the paper also reports generator shares and longer average turns than natural datasets. Those findings describe provenance trends, not content quality, consent, or model performance.

For representation, the paper reports creator-geography Gini coefficients of 0.92 for text, 0.86 for speech, and 0.74 for video. Although absolute language and country counts increase, most relative concentration measures do not significantly improve since 2013. This evidence is conditional on public datasets, partial creator identity, release-affiliation-to-headquarters mapping, and the exclusion of proprietary data.

Artifact inspection confirms an Apache-2.0 repository with modality JSON directories and tooling, plus an official 38-page supplemental Attribution Card citing 455 dataset papers. It also reveals release drift: the only GitHub release is v1.1.0 from June 2024, the checked main commit is ce6662deccf011574427b6f112df479d261960b8 from March 2025, and the README still describes the earlier 44-collection text audit. Thus the audit is available, but no frozen paper-time multimodal manifest was identified.

Table 1 是规模基准：总计 3,916 个数据集，其中 3,717 个文本、95 个语音、104 个视频；覆盖 798 个来源、659 个创建机构、67 个国家、608 种语言、443 项任务和 55 种许可证。文本规模为 2.1T token，语音与视频分别为 775K 和 1.13M 小时。这些是元数据与生态规模统计，不是逐条独立核验的源记录数量。

核心限制结果比较数据集许可证与来源条款。论文报告只有 25%、33% 和 32% 的文本、语音、视频数据集采用非商业许可证，但带有某种非商业来源限制的内容分别覆盖 99.8%、78% 和 99% 的 token/小时数量。license/source 不一致占文本 token 的 79%、语音小时的 55% 和视频小时的 65%。详细 crosstab 中，按论文 taxonomy，同时在许可证和来源条款下可商业使用的文本不足 0.1%，语音为 5.4%，视频为 0.6%。

这些数字证明论文 taxonomy 下存在文档冲突，并不判断法律可执行性。作者明确把结论限制在 provenance 与 license/terms 分布，承认司法辖区和具体用途会影响判断，也声明该工作不会为所有开发者制定统一标准。

来源分析称 71% 的视频小时与 69% 的语音小时来自 YouTube；general web、encyclopedia、synthetic 与 social source 也日益主导文本。对合成文本，论文还报告了生成模型份额以及比自然数据更长的平均 turn。它们描述 provenance 趋势，不衡量内容质量、同意或模型性能。

在表示方面，论文报告 creator geography 的 Gini 系数为：文本 0.92、语音 0.86、视频 0.74。虽然语言和国家的绝对数量上升，多数相对集中度指标自 2013 年以来没有显著改善。该结论依赖公开数据集、部分创建者身份、release affiliation 到总部国家的映射，并排除了 proprietary data。

artifact 检查确认：Apache-2.0 仓库包含各模态 JSON 目录和工具；官方 38 页补充 Attribution Card 引用了 455 篇数据集论文。同时也发现 release 漂移：唯一 GitHub release 是 2024 年 6 月的 v1.1.0，检查的 main commit 是 2025 年 3 月的 ce6662deccf011574427b6f112df479d261960b8，README 仍描述早期 44 个 collection 的文本审计。因此审计材料确实可得，但没有找到冻结的论文时点多模态 manifest。

title: Novelty
新意
html:
The contribution is a cross-modal provenance audit that treats dataset licenses and upstream source restrictions as separate objects. Earlier catalogues often stop at a dataset card or one modality; this work follows derivation chains and adds source-policy categories, creator geography, language, task, and longitudinal sourcing signals across text, speech, and video.

The catalogue also separates collection- from dataset-level analysis. This matters for post-training text mixtures: one collection can contain both permissive and restrictive components, and a collection-level label can hide filterable subsets. The strictest-constituent rule makes the aggregation policy inspectable instead of silently averaging incompatible rights claims.

Publishing structured JSON, constants, filter/normalization tools, analysis plots, and an Attribution Card makes the audit operational. A data builder can create a review queue or select components by declared attributes rather than relying only on prose. At the same time, modality-specific schemas and a living repository mean that operational availability is not equivalent to a frozen, uniform paper release.

For reasoning-data research, the novelty is governance infrastructure rather than a new reasoning dataset or verifier. The text scope explicitly includes SFT and preference-alignment collections, including reasoning and tool-use sources, but the audit supplies metadata about those sources—not their traces, rewards, correctness labels, or benchmark decontamination.

该工作的贡献是一个跨模态 provenance 审计，它把数据集许可证与上游来源限制视为两个独立对象。既有目录往往停留在数据卡或单一模态；本工作继续追踪派生链，并跨文本、语音与视频加入来源政策类别、创建者地域、语言、任务和长期 sourcing 信号。

目录还区分 collection-level 与 dataset-level 分析。对后训练文本 mixture 而言，这一点很重要：一个 collection 可能同时含有宽松和受限组件，collection 标签会隐藏可筛出的子集。采用最严格 constituent 的规则使聚合策略可检查，而不是把不兼容的权利主张静默平均。

结构化 JSON、constants、筛选/归一化工具、分析图与 Attribution Card 让审计具有操作性。数据构建者可以依据显式属性建立复核队列或选择组件，而不只依赖论文叙述。但各模态 schema 不同、仓库持续更新，意味着“可以操作”不等于“存在冻结且统一的论文发布物”。

对推理数据研究而言，新意在治理基础设施，而不是新的 reasoning dataset 或 verifier。文本范围明确包含 SFT 与 preference-alignment collection，其中也有 reasoning 和 tool-use 来源；审计提供这些来源的元数据，却不提供其轨迹、reward、correctness label 或 benchmark decontamination。

title: Limitations
局限
html:
The audit is dataset-level. A collection or dataset label can conceal records from different creators, platforms, licenses, consent regimes, and transformations. “Derived from” links help trace reuse but do not establish which examples overlap, which license applies to each record, or whether a benchmark item entered training. The resource therefore cannot replace record-level lineage or contamination checks.

Human judgment reliability is under-specified. The paper describes domain experts, legal analysis, full source tracing, and fields such as License Verified By, but it does not report field-level coverage, reviewer assignment, training materials, disagreement resolution, or inter-annotator agreement. Public documents can themselves be incomplete, stale, contradictory, or later changed, and the release does not provide a complete timestamped evidence snapshot for every label.

The legal taxonomy is intentionally simplified. Commercial/NC/Unspecified and Model Closed/Source Closed/Unspecified/Unrestricted compress licenses, platform contracts, model-output terms, and jurisdiction-specific questions into comparison categories. Strictest-source aggregation is conservative, yet it neither resolves compatibility among multiple obligations nor constitutes legal advice or clearance.

Coverage is selected, not exhaustive. Popularity, public availability, task tags, surveys, citation/download thresholds, workshop lists, and expert additions privilege visible ecosystems. Private/proprietary training data are absent. Text, speech, and video also use different inclusion rules, schemas, version handling, and size units, so cross-modal totals should not be interpreted as a uniform random sample.

Representation measures have operational limits. “Creator organization” means an affiliation associated with releasing the ML dataset, not an upstream content owner or individual contributor. Headquarters mapping, multi-organization counting, partial identities, missing usage frequency, and unobserved proprietary data constrain geography and Gini conclusions. Higher dataset counts do not measure whose content, labor, or consent is represented.

Versioning is not paper-frozen. The accepted PDF internally gives 3,717 and 3,713 text datasets. The repository's only release, v1.1.0, predates the paper; current main has later modality files, while the README still describes the older 44-collection text audit and cites the 2023 paper. The checked tree contains 110 text JSON files including a template, 95 speech files, and 105 video files, but file counts cannot be equated with paper dataset counts.

Licenses remain layered. Apache-2.0 covers the repository material, not the underlying data, source works, model outputs, or platform access. The official Hugging Face organization contains multiple filtered or normalized artifacts but no single identified repository representing the full 2025 multimodal audit. Reusing a filtered dataset still requires checking every upstream license, term, privacy obligation, and access condition.

该审计停留在 dataset level。collection 或 dataset 标签可能掩盖来自不同创建者、平台、许可证、同意机制与转换方式的记录；Derived from 可以提示复用关系，却不能说明哪些样本重叠、每条记录适用何种 license、或 benchmark 样本是否进入训练。因此它不能替代逐记录 lineage 与 contamination check。

人工判断可靠性披露不足。论文描述了 domain expert、legal analysis、完整 source tracing，也在部分 schema 中设置 License Verified By，但没有报告逐字段覆盖、reviewer 分配、培训材料、分歧处理或 inter-annotator agreement。公开文档本身可能缺失、过期、矛盾或后来变更，发布物也没有为每个标签保存完整的带时间证据快照。

法律 taxonomy 有意简化。Commercial/NC/Unspecified 与 Model Closed/Source Closed/Unspecified/Unrestricted 把许可证、平台合同、模型输出条款和司法辖区问题压缩成比较类别。最严格来源聚合较为保守，但既不解决多项义务之间的兼容性，也不构成法律意见或 clearance。

覆盖范围经过选择，并非穷举。热度、公开可见性、任务 tag、survey、引用/下载阈值、workshop 清单和专家补充都会偏向显眼生态；private/proprietary training data 不在其中。文本、语音、视频还采用不同纳入规则、schema、版本处理和规模单位，因此跨模态总数不能理解成统一随机样本。

表示指标有操作性限制。“creator organization”是发布 ML 数据集时关联的 affiliation，不是上游内容所有者或个人贡献者。总部映射、多机构重复计数、部分身份、缺失的使用频率与不可见 proprietary data 都会限制地域和 Gini 结论。数据集数量更高也不等于内容、劳动或同意得到了更充分代表。

版本没有在论文时点冻结。录用 PDF 内部同时写有 3,717 与 3,713 个文本数据集。仓库唯一 release v1.1.0 早于论文；当前 main 增加了后续多模态文件，而 README 仍描述旧的 44-collection 文本审计并引用 2023 论文。检查树中有 110 个文本 JSON（含 template）、95 个语音 JSON 和 105 个视频 JSON，但文件数不能直接等同于论文数据集数。

许可证必须分层。Apache-2.0 只覆盖 repository material，不覆盖底层数据、来源作品、模型输出或平台访问。官方 Hugging Face 组织包含多个筛选或归一化 artifact，但未发现一个单独仓库代表完整 2025 多模态审计。即使复用筛选后的数据，也仍需检查所有上游 license、term、隐私义务和访问条件。

title: Usefulness
用途
html:
For data_construction_open_release_recipes, this work supplies a pre-ingestion audit layer. A reasoning-data builder can query upstream sources, parent datasets, generating models, human annotation, creator organizations, languages, tasks, licenses, and source restrictions before combining SFT, preference, tool-use, or multimodal components. Conflicts can become an explicit rights-review queue instead of disappearing beneath a mixture-level license.

An auditable reuse workflow should pin a repository commit, retain the audit's stable dataset identifier, and store the exact source-document URL, retrieval time, evidence snapshot or hash, reviewer, taxonomy version, and unresolved fields. Mixture records should preserve both the dataset license and every upstream source/model term rather than collapsing them into a single permissive label. Corrections should be versioned at field level.

The catalogue can also help stratify audits: identify model-generated datasets, trace parent collections, compare collection- and dataset-level restrictions, find missing licenses, or analyze which reasoning sources come from a narrow geography or language distribution. Its downloader/filter tooling may assist construction, but users should separate provenance metadata from the downloaded training records and revalidate live access terms.

It cannot certify data quality, correctness, safety, or legal use. It contains no reasoning traces, process labels, rewards, terminal outcomes, or sample-level verifier decisions. Benchmark performance would not repair those omissions. High-stakes reuse still needs record-level provenance, privacy/consent review, contamination analysis, content inspection, and counsel appropriate to the relevant jurisdiction.

As an open-release case study, it demonstrates why a paper, a living GitHub repository, a tagged release, an explorer, a supplemental Attribution Card, and an HF organization are distinct artifacts. Downstream cards and model reports should name the exact revision used and disclose which of those layers were actually consulted.

在 data_construction_open_release_recipes track 中，该工作提供数据摄取前的审计层。推理数据构建者可在组合 SFT、preference、tool-use 或多模态组件之前查询上游来源、父数据集、生成模型、人工标注、创建机构、语言、任务、许可证和来源限制，把冲突转成显式权利复核队列，而不是让它们消失在 mixture-level license 下。

可审计的复用流程应固定 repository commit，保留审计中的 stable dataset identifier，并记录每个 source-document 的精确 URL、获取时间、证据快照或 hash、reviewer、taxonomy version 与 unresolved field。mixture record 应同时保留 dataset license 和所有 upstream source/model term，不能压缩成一个宽松标签；修正也应按字段版本化。

该目录还可用于分层审计：识别 model-generated dataset、追踪 parent collection、比较 collection/dataset 两级限制、查找缺失 license，或分析 reasoning source 是否集中在少数地域和语言。downloader/filter 工具可以辅助构造，但使用者应把 provenance metadata 与实际下载的训练记录分开，并重新核查实时访问条款。

它不能认证数据质量、正确性、安全性或合法使用。资源中没有 reasoning trace、process label、reward、terminal outcome 或样本级 verifier decision，benchmark 性能也不能弥补这些缺口。高风险复用仍需逐记录 provenance、隐私/同意复核、污染分析、内容检查，以及针对相关司法辖区的专业意见。

作为开放发布案例，它还说明 paper、living GitHub repository、tagged release、explorer、补充 Attribution Card 与 HF organization 是不同 artifact。下游 Card 与 model report 应明确写出所用 revision，以及究竟检查了哪些层。

title: Reading notes
阅读笔记
html:
• Use 3,916 as Table 1's cross-modal total: 3,717 text, 95 speech, and 104 video. Preserve the same paper's separate 3,713-text statement as unresolved.
  • The object is collection/dataset/separable-variant metadata, not per-record provenance and not a released reasoning-trace corpus.
  • Keep dataset licenses separate from upstream source/model terms; the audit uses strictest-source categories for aggregation, not legal judgments.
  • Read restriction percentages with their denominators: dataset counts differ from token/hour quantities, and collection-level text labels inherit the most restrictive constituent.
  • Pin repository revision ce6662deccf011574427b6f112df479d261960b8; v1.1.0 predates the paper, the README describes the older text-only scope, and no paper-time manifest was found.
  • Still unknown are field-level annotation coverage/agreement, frozen evidence snapshots, correction semantics, and record-level source, consent, transformation, license, and overlap lineage.

• Table 1 的跨模态总数是 3,916：文本 3,717、语音 95、视频 104；同一论文另写的 3,713 个文本数据集必须保留为未解决差异。
  • 数据对象是 collection/dataset/可分离变体级元数据，不是逐记录 provenance，也不是 reasoning trace 语料。
  • 区分 dataset license 与 upstream source/model term；审计用最严格来源类别做聚合，而不是作法律判决。
  • 阅读限制比例时先确认分母：dataset count 与 token/hour quantity 不同，collection-level 文本标签还继承最严格 constituent。
  • 固定 repository revision ce6662deccf011574427b6f112df479d261960b8；v1.1.0 早于论文，README 仍描述旧文本范围，且未发现 paper-time manifest。
  • 仍为 unknown 的信息包括逐字段标注覆盖/一致性、冻结证据快照、修正语义，以及逐记录来源、同意、转换、license 与 overlap lineage。

value.html: Publicly available text, speech, and video datasets selected through modality-specific combinations of Hugging Face task/download listings, surveys, repositories, workshop proceedings, citation/download thresholds, open-model SFT/DPO releases, multilingual catalogues, and domain-expert additions
Collection-, dataset-, or separable-variant-level JSON metadata plus aggregate plots and an Attribution Card; it is not a record-level mapping from each training example to an original source

Human domain experts trace dataset documentation through papers, websites, repositories, marketplaces, source terms, and derivation chains; repository scripts add inferred platform metadata and support download/filter/normalization

A manual audit over mutable public documentation and terms, backed by modality-specific JSON schemas, constants, analysis plots, downloader/filter/normalization code, a JavaScript explorer, and a 38-page supplemental Attribution Card

Human legal/ML and modality expertise plus cross-checking of public source documents. Dataset licenses are grouped as Commercial, NC/Acad, or Unspecified; source terms as Model Closed, Source Closed, Unspecified, or Unrestricted, with strictest-source aggregation. No model reward or independent gold verifier is provided.

An item falls within modality-specific scope and its selected metadata is encoded for the audit; exact field-completeness thresholds, disagreement resolution, and per-entry acceptance logs are unknown
not applicable; the release is a human-audited metadata catalogue rather than model-generated training data
Human modality experts and legal/ML reviewers; exact reviewer assignment and training materials are unknown

Human research teams create the audit JSON and legal/source labels; repository scripts retrieve platform metadata, normalize selected underlying datasets, filter by audit attributes, and generate attribution output

Define a modality-specific scope -> compile candidates from public catalogues and expert sources -> trace dataset and derivation documentation back to source terms -> annotate identity, source, creator, representation, license, and restriction fields -> apply strictest-source/collection aggregation for analysis -> publish JSON, plots, tools, and Attribution Card
Table 1 reports 3916 audited datasets, comprising 3717 text, 95 speech, and 104 video entries; §2.1 separately states 3713 text datasets, an unresolved internal discrepancy
not applicable

Text prioritizes public post-training SFT/preference datasets and popular/recent collections; speech retains datasets where ASR is a primary task and excludes unlabeled hours; video uses specified task tags, publication/citation or Hugging Face download criteria, workshops, survey repositories, and expert review. Semantically or legally distinct versions can remain separate.
Human audit time, number of reviewers per field, and adjudication budget are unknown; this is not an inference-time generation recipe

Modality-specific taxonomies and JSON schemas, strictest-source restriction aggregation, dataset download/filter/normalization functions, analysis notebooks/plots, a public explorer, and a contribution workflow

Table 1 reports 3916 public datasets spanning 798 sources, 659 creator organizations, 67 countries, 608 languages, 443 tasks, and 55 licenses; text covers 108 collections and 2.1T tokens, while speech/video cover about 1.9M hours. Selection intentionally differs by modality and excludes proprietary datasets.

Not a train/dev/test corpus. Text, speech, and video have distinct candidate-selection and version-handling rules; a frozen paper-time inclusion/exclusion manifest mapping every paper statistic to one repository commit is unavailable.
No sample-level decontamination is performed. Derived-from and source annotations can expose dataset-level reuse, but they do not prove record overlap or benchmark contamination.

items: Popularity, public availability, task tags, citation/download thresholds, workshop lists, and expert additions create selection bias; private and proprietary training data are outside the observed ecosystem.
The three modalities use different scopes, counting units, schemas, version rules, and size measures, limiting direct cross-modal comparisons.
Public dataset cards, repositories, licenses, and Terms of Service can be missing, stale, ambiguous, changed, or wrong; the release does not preserve a complete evidence snapshot for every judgment.
Commercial/NC/Unspecified and Model Closed/Source Closed/Unspecified/Unrestricted categories compress legally complex, jurisdiction-dependent terms and are not legal determinations.

Dataset- or collection-level labels can conceal incompatible record-level sources, consent states, transformations, and licenses; strictest-source aggregation is conservative but does not provide per-example clearance.

Creator organizations mean affiliations associated with the ML dataset release, not owners or creators of upstream source content; headquarters-based geography and partial identities limit representation inference.
Field-level annotation coverage, reviewer assignment, disagreement resolution, and inter-annotator agreement are not reported, so human-label error cannot be quantified from the paper.
The accepted paper internally reports both 3717 and 3713 text datasets; these figures must not be silently reconciled.
The repository is a living resource. Its only GitHub release, v1.1.0, predates the paper, while current main contains post-release multimodal changes and no immutable paper-time manifest.
The repository README still describes the earlier 44-collection/1800+ text audit and cites the 2023 paper, creating scope and version confusion for users of the 2025 multimodal analysis.

The official Hugging Face organization hosts multiple filtered/normalized artifacts but no single identified repository is the complete 2025 multimodal audit; the organization page must not be treated as a unified paper snapshot.

Apache-2.0 on audit metadata and tools does not transfer permissions for underlying training records or settle whether platform terms, dataset licenses, copyright, privacy, or consent obligations are enforceable or compatible.

value.html: The official repository is Apache-2.0, covering repository code and metadata. Every audited dataset, model output, source work, platform term, and downstream download remains governed independently. The exact paper license was not verified from an accessible ICLR/OpenReview metadata field; arXiv uses its non-exclusive distribution license.

Modality-specific public candidate sources -> human tracing across dataset cards, papers, repositories, and original source terms -> dataset/separable-variant JSON -> strictest-source and collection aggregation -> ecosystem statistics, Attribution Card, explorer, and filter/normalization tooling; no per-record lineage graph is released
